@@U02081@@
My lover was near, but he’s far away now; and the garland torn, blossoms scattered. Not so rough! Take hold gently! Spare me! Don't let me beg in vain! What did I ever do to you? I never saw you before!

@@U02083@@
How can I bear this misery!

@@U02085@@
I’m in your hands now, at your mercy. But first let me nurse my baby. I cuddled it all last night, you know, and then they came and took it away, to grieve me, grieve me, and now they say I murdered it. And [ll never be happy again. And they make up songs about me, they do, and they sing them, and it’s bad of them, wicked! There's an old tale that ends like that— but why mix it up with me?

@@U02087@@
(Throwing himself at her feet.)

@@U02088@@
A lover lies here at your feet, come to free you of this captive misery!

@@U02090@@
(Throwing herself down beside him.)

@@U02091@@
Yes, oh, yes,
translation:
@@U02081@@
我的爱人曾在近处，如今却在远方；花环撕裂，花朵散落。没那么粗暴！轻轻地握住！饶了我吧！别让我白白哀求！我对你做了什么？我以前从没见过你！

@@U02083@@
我怎能承受这样的痛苦！

@@U02085@@
我现在在你的手中，任由你摆布。但首先让我给我的孩子喂奶。你知道，我昨晚一直抱着它，然后他们来把它拿走了，让我悲伤，让我悲伤，现在他们说我谋杀了它。并且[永远不会再快乐。他们创作了关于我的歌曲，他们确实这么做了，他们还唱这些歌，他们很糟糕，很邪恶！有一个古老的故事就是这样结束的——但为什么要把它和我混在一起呢？

@@U02087@@
（扑倒在她脚边。）

@@U02088@@
一位爱人躺在你的脚下，来将你从这种被囚禁的痛苦中解脱出来！

@@U02090@@
（扑倒在他身边。）

@@U02091@@
是啊，哦，是啊，
